lines.label: B1
lines.reason: This is the long 90.7 deg fold between the plate and the flange (patches 2/3). In perpendicular sections at 2/25/50/75/98% the label point sits on the convex outer-skin apex of the rounded corner. Its distance to the nearest scan point is 0.04-0.16 mm, and the inner skin is about 1.5 mm inward along the bisector. The fold is present from t=0.5 to t=150.0 mm of the 150.9 mm line and runs the full length between the end relief notches. There are no gaps and the fold does not extend past either end. The line is parallel to the fold.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: This is the 44.4 deg tab fold at the +u flange end (patches 4/6). Sections show the label on the convex outer apex of the obtuse 135.6 deg corner, 0.01-0.13 mm from the nearest point, with the inner skin about 1.45 mm inward. The fold is present over t=-0.5 to 18.0 mm, against a 17.6 mm line, so 18.5 of 19 mm is covered. The line runs from the flange free edge down to the relief notch above the plate. The 'from bisector' close-up and the face-on close-up confirm it is parallel.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: This is the 44.2 deg tab fold at the -u flange end (patches 4/7), the mirror of B2. The label is on the convex outer apex in every section, 0.03-0.18 mm from the nearest point, with the inner skin about 1.5 mm inward. The fold is present over t=-0.5 to 18.0 mm against a 17.6 mm line, from the flange edge to the relief notch. It is parallel to the fold.
